verdict.rationale: Linear documents cloud coding sessions run by Linear Agent (linear-docs-44, linear-docs-21), and its changelog says you can 'restore to any previous checkpoint from version history' (linear-docs-35). However, the evidence never ties that checkpoint restore to coding-agent sessions rather than to agent-edited documents (linear-docs-34), so it is unclear whether this capability covers the story at all. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that checkpoint restore applies to coding-agent sessions, documentation of how session checkpoints are created and restored, independent or hands-on corroboration.
